lane: sites (his sites and everything that publishes)

features.name: Build a whole website for a business, event or person
features.where: Ask in the chat (Talk to me); progress in MAKE → WORKSHOP → PROJECTS
say: Build a website for my friend's barber shop in Walsall
Make a site for my football team
features.does: Plans the pages, finds free credited photos, writes the words, checks and critiques it, then publishes it at its own free link
features.note: Anything I had to guess (hours, prices) keeps it as a private draft until you confirm the list. Forms work only through your own free Formspree address, or open WhatsApp/email

features.name: Confirm a draft website and put it live
say: Yes, those hours are right, put it live
features.does: Puts the draft live once you confirm what I assumed, behind APPROVE

features.name: Make a mini-app for the Home Screen
say: Make me a water tracker app
Make a tip calculator for the group
Make me flash cards for French verbs
features.does: Builds a tracker, list, timer, calculator, counter, habit grid, notes pad, flash cards or a small game; it installs from its link, saves on the phone and works offline
features.note: Nine kinds only. No live data, no syncing between phones, no reminders

features.name: Put a studio game on your sites
features.where: MAKE → GAME STUDIO → a game → AS AN APP → PUT IT ON MY SITES, or the chat
say: Put Fox Run on my sites
Put my game on my sites
features.does: Your game as its own page: installs on a Home Screen, plays offline, keeps its saves; live only after APPROVE, every time
features.note: The game must be open in the studio when you ask

features.name: Rebuild a website, better
say: Rebuild this site but better: https://example.com
features.does: Studies a site's layout, words, colours and scripts, then writes a faster phone-first version and publishes it, labelled as not the official site
features.note: The copy is a look-alike only: no logins, carts or real forms

features.name: Put a page online
say: Make a page for my party and put it online
features.does: Publishes one page I write at a free link the moment you tap APPROVE, after a quality check

features.name: Long pages in parts
say: Make a long guide to every café in my town and put it online
features.does: Builds a big page in pieces and publishes it as one, up to 400 KB

features.name: Check a page before it goes up
say: Check the page you made me
features.does: Lists broken tags, script errors and missing basics, line by line; a page with errors is never published

features.name: The pages I put online
features.where: MAKE → WORKSHOP → PUBLISHED PAGES, or the chat
say: Give me the link to my CV again
features.does: Every page, app and game with its link, size and date; open or take down from there

features.name: Take a page down
features.where: WORKSHOP → PUBLISHED PAGES, or the chat
features.does: The link stops working for everyone; an installed app or game forgets itself

features.name: Little games and tools in the chat (widgets)
say: Make me a little snake game
features.does: A sealed little game or tool that runs right in the chat
features.note: Lives in the chat only: not on your sites, not installable

features.name: Remove a widget
features.does: Removes a widget you no longer want

features.name: Build projects you can follow
features.does: Each website or app build shows its steps, what is running now and the report; RESUME or RUN NEXT NOW if it stopped

features.name: Export a game as one file
features.where: MAKE → GAME STUDIO → a game → AS AN APP → Export
features.does: One self-contained page kept in the studio's library, to save as a file

features.name: Link previews
features.does: Pages carry a title, description and picture, so a shared link shows a proper card

features.name: Pages stay up when the brain's database is paused
features.does: Published pages, apps and games are kept in a second free store and served without the brain

upward.idea: A real editor for his sites: change any word, photo or price on a live page by tapping it or saying it, shown as a marked change he accepts
upward.why: Today a change means asking for a rebuild; this makes his sites his to tend
upward.builds_on: the website builder's blocks and the editors' accept/reject proposals

upward.idea: Version history and one-tap UNDO for every published page
upward.why: A bad update can be rolled back in seconds
upward.builds_on: the store of his published pages

upward.idea: A private, cookie-free visitor count on each page (views per day, no tracking of who)
upward.why: He sees whether his site is used, without spying on anyone
upward.builds_on: the server that shows his pages, and its free storage

upward.idea: Tidier links: short names, a QR code on every page card, and his own domain only if he already owns one (nothing bought)
upward.why: Easier to share on a poster, a van or a business card
upward.builds_on: the list of his pages and the phone's QR maker

upward.idea: More website kinds and multi-language pages (Urdu, Polish, Arabic…) from one request
upward.why: Fits the businesses and people around him
upward.builds_on: the website templates and the translation he already has

upward.idea: Mini-apps that can be edited after they are made (add a habit, change a goal) by voice
upward.why: Today an app is fixed once built
upward.builds_on: the mini-app kit and its settings

upward.idea: More mini-app kinds: a workout log, a reading list, a recipe box, a packing list, a shared-scoreboard style score sheet
upward.why: More of his everyday needs as apps on his Home Screen

upward.idea: A home page for all his sites, opt-in, listing only the pages he chooses
Accessibility and speed report card on each page, re-run weekly with fixes proposed
upward.why: Keeps his pages specialist-grade over time
upward.builds_on: the page check and the website quality checks

upward.idea: Game pages with a scoreboard kept on the player's phone and a share card of a high score
upward.why: Makes his games feel finished and shareable

upward.idea: A gallery page for a published game: its rooms as pictures, how to play, the maker's note
upward.why: A proper landing page instead of straight into the game
upward.builds_on: the studio's room drawings and icon

upward.idea: Photo choice he controls: pick from his own photos for a site, kept credited and resized on the phone
upward.why: His real business in the pictures, nothing stock
upward.builds_on: the website builder's picture step and the photo editor

sideways.idea: Event pages with RSVPs that open WhatsApp or email to him, and add-to-calendar buttons
sideways.why: Parties and club nights without a sign-up site
sideways.builds_on: the website builder's forms and the agenda

sideways.idea: A printable poster and flyer for any page, with its QR code
sideways.why: The same site, on paper, at once
sideways.builds_on: the page builder and DOCS/SLIDES export

sideways.idea: Slides published as a page: a deck at its own link that plays on any phone
sideways.why: Share a talk without sending a file

sideways.idea: A written document or report published as a clean read-only page
sideways.why: Share a guide or letter as a link
sideways.builds_on: DOCS and putting a page online

sideways.idea: A comic he made, published as a swipeable reader page that installs and works offline
sideways.builds_on: the COMIC editor and the game page's installable route

sideways.idea: A menu or price list page that updates when he edits a sheet
sideways.why: One source of truth for a café or a trade

sideways.idea: A portfolio page made from his own photos and videos
sideways.why: A clean showcase in one request
sideways.builds_on: the photo and video editors and the website builder

sideways.idea: Mini-apps made from a sheet: a table becomes a list or tracker app
sideways.why: Turns his own data into a phone app

sideways.idea: A link-in-bio page for his social accounts, posts shown only after APPROVE
sideways.why: One public link for everything he shares
sideways.builds_on: the social screen and the sites route

sideways.idea: Workshop apps as installable pages: a tool he built in the Workshop published like a mini-app
sideways.why: Use his own tools away from Ghosty
sideways.builds_on: the widgets and the game page's installable route

cross.idea: A business site whose opening hours and closures come from his agenda
cross.why: No double typing; the site is never wrong about when he is open

cross.idea: Learn: flash-card decks from his studies published as an installable mini-app
A garden or home project page made from the Workspace with its photos
cross.why: Share progress with family by link

cross.idea: A walking or running route page from his own saved places (never live location)
cross.why: Share a route without sharing where he is

cross.idea: A recipe page or box from the Kitchen with timers inside
cross.why: Recipes he can cook from on any phone

cross.idea: Boot or brand look: his sites wear one of Ghosty's seven looks, or a look matched to his business
cross.why: Every page he publishes looks like his own
